text.card: K2-122B is a star of 3,291 K, bound to K2-122 1,452 AU away.
text.introduction: K2-122B shares its motion through space with K2-122, 1,452 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: K2-122B's orbit around K2-122 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
